I replied to Tobias in our DM. Here is what I told him:

- **Door 14 barcode scanners:** Ticket #4419 covers this. It's in the North team cheat sheet, a public file with no date (teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md). Thea Ramaswell, QFL's Director of Yard Operations, logged it because the gatehouse scanners at Door 14 weren't reading trailer tags on third shift. The ticket then went to tier-2 product support for firmware testing. I couldn't find a resolution or any later update.
- **Eau Claire gatehouse kiosk alerts:** I found nothing in his channels, our DMs or the public files, so I can't say whether anyone has reported it. I suggested he ask the North team, who handle QFL: Marcus Lindqvist, Dana Okafor and Ilse Varga.
- **Name mix-up:** I warned him that Quarendon Freightways (one "r") is a different Duluth company and isn't a customer. Marcus's Aug 2025 note is about them, not QFL.

I only looked at what Tobias can see himself. I didn't read #inc-qfl-sev1 or #north-team because he isn't a member of either, so anything the North team has posted there isn't in my answer.
